overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to discuss and compile councilors' priorities for the fiscal year 2027 annual budget process.

items.title: FY 2027 Budget Recommendations to the Mayor (Paper 26-061)
items.summary: The committee discussed councilors' budget priorities—including school funding, department staffing, infrastructure, public safety, and arts programs—and voted to refer the recommendations to the regular city council meeting.

subject: FY 2027 Budget Priorities
